full_name: David Gruber | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: At Radcliffe, David Gruber is undertaking a book-length project on the history of jellyfish and other gelatinous marine life. He is also working with the Harvard Microrobotics Laboratory to develop soft robotic devices for undersea exploration and research.
